name: design-scope-preservation
goal: Keep all unrequested page regions faithful to the reference while generating options for the requested visual change.

evidence: A page request such as change the right panel may attach a current or wanted full-page image; all other page content and styling must remain faithful to that reference, while explicitly requested whole-page changes remain possible.

The existing three-option page Plan case checks reference bytes and option count but never checks that generator prompts confine design directions to the requested panel or preserve other areas. Extend its synthetic wanted/current/missing reference matrix and existing scenario without real image calls.
